references.text: David seeks refuge in prayer under difficult circumstances, reflecting Jesus' actions in Gethsemane.
The prophecy of a suffering servant who gives himself in prayer and submission to God's will, parallel to Jesus' prayer in Gethsemane.
Mark's parallel account of Jesus' arrival at Gethsemane and his instructions to the disciples.
Luke's description of Jesus' arrival at the place of prayer, which is also Gethsemane, and his prayer.
John mentions that Jesus crossed the Kidron brook, where there was a garden, suggesting Gethsemane, even though it is not named.
